issues.title: Assets disappear after 15 seconds (heartbeat)
issues.body:
This is an intermittent error. It doesn't happen on some builds.

But, the issue is that every 15 seconds, the assets all disappear from the map.

This happens in response to the `heartbeat` message being sent.  It _looks-like_ new state is passed through to `factory.tsx`, which trigger state updates that mean the asset list gets cleared.

1. We should find a way of the heartbeat not clearing the assets
2. We should cancel the heartbeat functionality

I've just opened the heroku instance here, and it doesn't have the problem:
https://serge-sql.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-l6nngxlk&access=blue-mtg-1

But, the same build on a different network does have the issue.
